verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a public REST Marketing Emails API. It supports programmatic create, update and get operations, post-send statistics, and concrete endpoints such as GET /marketing/v3/emails and /marketing/v3/emails/{emailId}. The docs are also served as machine-readable markdown pages. missing for 10: evidence of API coverage beyond marketing emails (e.g., campaigns, forms, workflows), a published OpenAPI spec (all probed OpenAPI paths returned 404), documented auth/rate-limit details, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You can use the Marketing Emails API to programmatically create, update, and get details about marketing emails.
To retrieve a list of all emails, make a `GET` request to `/marketing/v3/emails`, and include any filters as query parameters in your request
You can also query details about the post-send statistics of a specific email or set of emails.
